# A crystal cluster: a tall hexagonal shard and three shorter ones leaning out, each a prism
# with a pointed tip; the faces turned to +x slate, the rest pale (unlit: they glow). On a stippled pool of
# light (halo.png, alpha-masked) 0.56 m in radius. Origin on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Shard --base-color 0.6980 0.8353 0.8196 --no-slot --emission 0.6980 0.8353 0.8196
material new Facet --base-color 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176 --no-slot --emission 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176
material new Halo --base-color 1 1 1 --emission 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176 --no-slot
material texture Halo base-color halo.png
material set Halo alpha-mode mask
material set Halo alpha-cutoff 0.5
add mesh cylinder --name P0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.4 --location 0 0 0.200
add mesh cone --name T0 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.16 --radius2 0 --depth 0.256 --location 0 0 0.528
select P0 T0
active P0
join
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.0 0.0 0
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name P1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.11 --depth 0.24 --location 0 0 0.120
add mesh cone --name T1 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.176 --location 0 0 0.328
select P1 T1
active P1
join
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
set rotation 30 0 115
apply --rotation
set location 0.2 -0.07 0
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name P2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.105 --depth 0.22 --location 0 0 0.110
add mesh cone --name T2 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.105 --radius2 0 --depth 0.168 --location 0 0 0.304
select P2 T2
active P2
join
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
set rotation 32 0 235
apply --rotation
set location -0.18 -0.09 0
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name P3 --vertices 6 --radius 0.1 --depth 0.2 --location 0 0 0.100
add mesh cone --name T3 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0 --depth 0.160 --location 0 0 0.280
select P3 T3
active P3
join
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
set rotation 28 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.02 0.2 0
apply --location
select P0 P1 P2 P3
active P0
join
rename P0 Crystal
material assign Shard
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5"
material assign Facet
mode object
add mesh circle --name Halo --vertices 16 --radius 0.56 --cap-fill ngon --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Halo
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select Crystal
shade flat
export crystal.glb
